title: productCreate makes only one default variant, so multi-variant products need a second mutation
symptoms: Created product shows a single Default Title variant
Code that sent variants inside the productCreate input breaks after moving to a newer API version
REST POST /products.json is marked deprecated in the reference
cause: Since the 2024-04 product model, productCreate only makes the product and its first variant. Other variants go through productVariantsBulkCreate or productSet, and REST product create and list calls are deprecated.
fix: Create the product with its options, then add variants with productVariantsBulkCreate, or send the full state with productSet for imports.
affected: GraphQL Admin API 2024-04 and later; REST product endpoints deprecated from 2024-04
